actions.action: Refactor down tools/model/build_console.py - characterization test first, then extract the passive-component builder into its own module
actions.first_step: Add tools/model/test_build_console.py pinning the current output of build_passives, then extract it to tools/model/passives.py
actions.done_when: A characterization test asserts the current build_passives output byte-for-byte and passes; build_console.py drops below 800 LOC in the next /assess run's complexity-stats.json
actions.scope_fence: Only tools/model/; do not change the generated console output, and do not touch tools/model/measure.py in the same change

actions.action: Generate a line-coverage report in CI and read it for the top hotspots first
actions.first_step: Add a coverage reporter to the test block in vite.config.ts and run npm test -- --coverage in .github/workflows/ci.yml
actions.done_when: .assess/run-context.json .coverage_report.available is true on the next /assess run, and the top three hotspots carry a reported line-coverage number
actions.scope_fence: Report the number only; do not add a failing threshold in this change, and do not edit any test file to raise coverage

actions.action: Add a ruleset on main requiring the ci status check, so the lint, test and build gates block a merge
actions.first_step: gh api repos/bjcoombs/jet-fighters/rulesets --method POST with a required_status_checks rule naming the ci check, or set it in Settings then Rules
actions.done_when: gh api repos/bjcoombs/jet-fighters/rulesets returns a non-empty list and a PR with a red ci check cannot be merged
actions.scope_fence: Only the repository ruleset; do not change .github/workflows/ci.yml, and do not add a required-approval rule in the same change
